posts.name: Abhishek Darji
posts.cooked:
Respected Sir

I am appearing for Re-OPPE in system commands this term. I have completed BPT-2 and BPT-3 succesfully. But the scores are not reflected in the portal.

I have attached the synchro status. Please look into this matter.

Regards
Abhishek Darji

posts.name: Siddharth
posts.cooked: I don’t think BPT3 score has been published on the portal. I see only BPT1 and 2 so far.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Hope you submitted the BPTs in their respective submission window (after release date, before deadline date).

posts.name: Abhishek Darji
posts.cooked:
Yess Sir. Actually I am repeating only OPPE this term and as you can see the dates of submission of my assignment . You can see the date of submission of BPT-1,4 and 5 are of previous term.

This term BPT-2 and BPT-3 have been submitted before the deadline. The deadlines were 28 Oct mid night and 10 Nov Mid Night. Both the assignments are fairly completed before deadline.

Sir this is a serious request from my side that I have faced this issue last term too and had a lot of chaos. Please look into this carefully and help me out.

I have also the screenshots of the submissions of each individual assignement which I can email you if required.

Regards

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Noted. Will forward it.

@Subendu @Narayanan.POD please guide.

posts.name: Abhishek Darji
posts.cooked:
@Narayanan.POD @Subendu

Hello Sir
It has been 5 days and I haven’t received any update from your end. This is really annoying me now sir. I have completed every needful requirements still there is now response from your end.

posts.name: Subendu Gorai
posts.cooked:
Hello @DarjiAbhi_23
If you repeat only OPPE, then only the OPPE score will reflect, other scores will remain the same as last term.

posts.name: Pooja Kumari
posts.cooked:
@sayan @Subendu @Narayanan.POD

I am facing the same issue and i’m also repeating only oppe this term.

posts.name: Pooja Kumari
posts.cooked: But sir during registration of repeating oppe there have a condition for doing BPT’s agian.

posts.name: Abhishek Darji
posts.cooked:
Thank You @Subendu Sir for your response. But the concern is about the BPT scores. I was worried because BPT scores were the eligibility criteria for OPPE and since the BPT scores weren’t reflected, I was scared if my submissions were recorded and considered or not. Also only BPT-1 score was shown and not the other two so it mad me worry a little more.

I hope you understand and let me know if everything is good or not for me.

Regards
